channel.title: RVA Burlesque
channel.description: Burlesque shows in Richmond, VA. Confirmed dates only; tentative [TBD] dates are kept out of the feed until firmed up.

item.title: Cabaret UnHappy Hour on Thursday
item.description:
When: Thursday, September 24, 2026 · 6pm – 9pm

Where: The Poe Museum, 1914 East Main Street, Richmond, VA 23223, United States

A cabaret happy-hour event at The Poe Museum featuring live music, live burlesque, southern cuisine, and craft beer and wine, presented by Crazy Rooster Brewing and Goodwill CCVA.

item.title: Dazzling Debuts: A Burlesque Student Showcase
item.description:
When: Saturday, September 26, 2026 · 7:30pm

Where: Basic City Beer Co - RVA, 212 W 6th St, Richmond, VA 23224

Burlesque Right Meow and Scarlet Starlet present a student showcase featuring new burlesque performers making their debut, at Basic City Beer Co's Richmond taproom.

item.title: Orchard After Dark: A Burlesque Fantasy
item.description:
When: Friday, October 2, 2026 · 8pm

Where: Blue Bee Cider, 4811 Bethlehem Rd, Richmond, VA

Cost: $21.00

A sultry, whimsical burlesque experience set in an enchanted orchard at Blue Bee Cider, featuring Anya Yabbos, Boobarella, Twirlisha Devine, and Ellie Quinn, hosted by Venessa Chevelle. Doors 7:30PM, show 8:00PM, 18+.

item.title: 10/10 Pours and Pasties RVA: Halloween Edition
item.description:
When: Saturday, October 10, 2026 · 8:30pm – 11pm

Where: Strangeways Brewing, 3110 W Leigh St, Richmond, VA 23230

Burlesque Right Meow's Halloween-themed edition of Pours and Pasties, a burlesque and variety show at Strangeways Brewing in Scott's Addition.
